Some compensation questions require external information, such as public market commentary, competitor pay philosophies, or labor trends. In these cases, the[Pave Agent](https://www.pave.com/products/pave-agent) can now search the web to provide additional context.


For example, a recruiter may need to know a talent competitor's equity refresh policy, a manager may ask about recent changes to pay transparency rules in a specific state, or someone may need to confirm if the cost of living is increasing in a competitive market. The Agent can now retrieve this information, consider it alongside your compensation philosophy, and provide a single, sourced answer. This eliminates the need for additional steps or browser tabs.


If your question extends beyond Pave’s data, the Agent searches the web, evaluates the results, and provides a well-supported answer. All sources used are listed alongside the response, just as with your internal data.


## You're still in control


Web search is enabled by default, but you can easily disable it with a single click if you prefer the Agent to use only Pave’s data. No support ticket or wait time is required.


And if you're already working in[Claude, you don't even need to open Pave to do it](https://www.pave.com/blog-posts/pave-agent-mcp) — the Agent now goes wherever you work, so the same grounded, cited answer is one message away.


Try asking The Pave Agent a question today and see how it delivers.[Schedule a demo](https://www.pave.com/request-demo) !
